note: Prime Advantages granted by Dramatis Personae. Offered only when the character is in the army and the unit qualifies.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Pyrrhian Eternals
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: Models in the Unit for which this Prime Advantage was selected gain +1 to their Attacks Characteristic. Whilst Anrakyr has joined the Unit, Models in the Unit also gain the Impact (S) Special Rule.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Superior Maneuvers
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: The Unit for which this Prime Advantage was selected gains the Infiltrate (9) Special Rule and the Ethereal Interception Trait.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Eternal Engine
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: All Models in the Unit for which this Prime Advantage is selected gain the Ever-Living (5+) Special Rule. Toholk can join Units of Automata that have had this Prime Advantage selected for them, even though he has the Infantry Type.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Mechanical Augmentation
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: At the Start of Battle, the Controlling Player of a Unit with this Prime Advantage rolls a D6 and applies the following Benefit to this Unit for the duration of the battle: 1-2 Hardened Carapace: +1 Toughness. 3-4 Improved Optics: +1 Ballistic Skill. 5-6 Enhanced Servomotors: +1 Strength.
